rules.question: Which profile does a comparison page list?
rules.note: The leaderboard comparison lists the profile at Clone Hero's SP cap, and the fill comparison lists one profile per fill rule. A page that sets the cap or the fill rule on a lens by hand can list other records than the named variants name. Decided by: D115 (ADR 0031)

rules.question: Which stored records does a page list: those under its profile whose chart the library lists?
rules.decision: D87 item 4, D92, D115 (part A2, task A2-4, code-only)
must_not_match: const std::unordered_map<std::string, store::RecordRow> by_id = report::library_lookup(store, profile, library).ready;
rules.note: The two comparison pages each filtered ready_records by hand to the charts the library lists. A page that does so itself can disagree with the other about which results it shows. The path report joins this rule in task A2-2. Since REPORT-ALL-T4 the owner reads one RecordStore::lookup over the library's charts, so no source line calls ready_records. Decided by: D87 item 4, D92, D115 (task A2-4); plan 2026-10-15-report-covers-whole-library (T4; removed, git show ec91f8d1:docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-15-report-covers-whole-library.md)
